title: Silhouette Woman Over City
description: A large black silhouette of a woman's face and shoulders dominates the upper part of the scene with a bright yellow full moon where her mouth would be. In the foreground many smaller black silhouettes of people stand near a body of reflective water with one central woman in a long dress reaching toward the water while the background shows a city skyline under a colorful sky.
prompt: A surreal digital painting shows a giant black silhouette of a woman's head and shoulders filling the sky above a city skyline. A bright yellow full moon appears in the place of her mouth. In the foreground many smaller black human silhouettes stand by reflective water with one central woman in a long dress reaching out. The sky blends pink orange and teal colors with the city buildings visible in the distance.
